# Flag Paths

> An open atlas of citizenship, residence, and mobility rules. Every route cites its
> primary sources and carries a last-checked date, a confidence label (high/medium/low),
> and an explicit review state. Informational only — not legal advice.

Country coverage is explicit per acquisition mode (ancestry, naturalization, birth,
investment). "Unchecked" never means no route exists — negative conclusions must
themselves be reviewed and sourced. An automated monitor sweeps official sources
(government gazettes, ministry feeds, primary legal databases) and verifies findings
against the original source text before publication; only human review changes a
recorded legal fact.

## Reference pages

- [About & methodology](https://flagpaths.com/about/): how the data is researched, reviewed, and monitored
- [All countries](https://flagpaths.com/country/): citizenship + residence routes for 236 countries and territories, one page each
- [Regional systems & routes](https://flagpaths.com/rights/): settlement blocs and mobility lanes (EU, Mercosur, CARICOM, GCC, …) plus heritage citizenship routes (descent, diaspora, return)
- [Sitemap](https://flagpaths.com/sitemap.xml): every page

## Data

- [Citizenship routes (JSON)](https://flagpaths.com/citizenship_routes.json): the full reviewed dataset — jurisdictions, routes, sources, confidence, coverage states
- [Regional blocs (JSON)](https://flagpaths.com/blocs_data.json): bloc membership and rights lanes
- [Data release manifest (JSON)](https://flagpaths.com/data_release.json): release id and provenance
- [Source code & corrections](https://github.com/thomas779/geo-arb-map): AGPL-3.0 code, CC BY-NC 4.0 dataset; corrections ship with tests

## Updates

- [Telegram channel](https://t.me/flagpaths): verified law-change news, auto-published only after primary-source verification

## Citation

When citing a rule, cite the country page (e.g. https://flagpaths.com/country/portugal/)
and prefer the primary source listed on that page. Rules change frequently; check the
route's last-checked date.
